name: Acapulco H.E.A.T.
description: Acapulco H.E.A.T. is a 1993 syndicated television series that followed the Hemisphere Emergency Action Team [H.E.A.T.], a group of top-secret agents based in Acapulco, Mexico and recruited by C-5, a secret government coalition, to fight terrorism and international crime. The team kept a low profile, by acting as models and photographers who represented a Beach Fashion enterprise.

videos.title: Code Name: Checkmate (1)
videos.overview: In the series opener, the crime-fighting Hemisphere Emergency Action Team, H.E.A.T., receives an assignment to provide security at a counterterrorism summit, but its efforts are jeopardized by the wife of a prince.

videos.title: Code Name: Checkmate (2)
videos.overview: The team discovers that Strake, who was thought to be dead, is behind the kidnapping.

videos.title: Code Name: Honeymoon Lost
videos.overview: The team is given the mother of all assignments: protect honeymooning Gulf War hero Alex Lassiter without the commander's knowledge.

videos.title: Code Name: Strange Bedfellow
videos.overview: Ashley and Mike and Brett and Cat, pose as newlyweds at an island resort owned by a man suspected of contaminating the waters.

videos.title: Code Name: Million Dollar Ladies (a.k.a. Vanished)
videos.overview: Mike's suspicions of Ashley's friend Sergio Lanti are well founded: Lanti abducts her and makes her a captive in a white-slavery ring.

videos.title: Code Name: Feminine Intuition
videos.overview: H.E.A.T. travels to Colombia to stop Ashley's rival from assassinating the judge who's prosecuting a drug kingpin.

videos.title: Code Name: Desert Dragon
videos.overview: At a karate competition, Tommy goes undercover as a coach to protect the son of an influential member of the C-5.

videos.title: Code Name: Archangel
videos.overview: Mike's former colleague heads security at an exhibition of a Leonardo da Vinci that H.E.A.T. suspects is targeted for theft by a neo-Nazi.

videos.title: Code Name: Arabesque
videos.overview: Cat infiltrates a drug cartel run by former KGB agents to investigate the disappearance of a UN employee who may have joined the ring.

videos.title: Code Name: Body Double
videos.overview: Brett poses as the son of an industrialist to stop a kidnapping ring.

videos.title: Code Name: Perfect Specimen
videos.overview: Trailing a scientist suspected of developing biological weapons, the team stumbles onto part of his research, a man whose body's being genetically altered.

videos.title: Code Name: Easy Riders
videos.overview: Vacationers assist the H.E.A.T. in an effort to find the doctor who's running a black-market baby ring.

videos.title: Code Name: Rip Van Winkle
videos.overview: The H.E.A.T. goes undercover at a rest home for former agents to find the one who's leaking information about a spy working in Russia.

videos.title: Code Name: The Stalking Horse
videos.overview: The H.E.A.T. must identify the person sent to assassinate a Chinese dissident from a group of 146 guests at a resort hotel.

videos.title: Code Name: Frameup
videos.overview: Mike is framed for murder, kidnapped and held for ransom by a terrorist whose brother he captured and sent to prison.

videos.title: Code Name: Ghosts
videos.overview: A detective and a letter addressed to Ashley from a boyfriend thought to be dead complicate an investigation into an illegal arms ring.

videos.title: Code Name: Stranded
videos.overview: Stranded on a desert island, Cat, Krissie, Marcos and Tommy encounter a reclusive Vietnam veteran who believes that they are enemy soldiers.

videos.title: Code Name: Shamrock
videos.overview: Mike suspects that a high-school buddy, now linked with a terrorist group, may be planning an attack on politicians attending a free-trade conference in Mexico.

videos.title: Code Name: Stalemate (1)
videos.overview: The H.E.A.T. guards a former KGB agent attending a chess match, but the game may be up when the team's nemesis returns to assassinate the Russian.

videos.title: Code Name: Stalemate (2)
videos.overview: Mike and Ashley match wits with Strake, who demands Sokol in return for Krissie.

videos.title: Code Name: Deep Six
videos.overview: Cat bristles when the deep-sea diver she and Brett are assigned to protect refuses to allow her on an expedition.

videos.title: Code Name: Assassin
videos.overview: When Mike is shot, Ashley immediately suspects Neil Strake. But there's one problem -- Strake's being held in a high-security facility in Mexico.

videos.title: Code Name: The Raven (1)
videos.overview: The team is restructured and given a tough assignment: find a criminal who stole a warehouse full of art.

videos.title: Code Name: The Raven (2)
videos.overview: The newly re-formed H.E.A.T. bands together to cage The Raven.

videos.title: Code Name: Spear of Destiny
videos.overview: The H.E.A.T. searches for a religious icon rumored to have mystical powers, which is also being sought by a dangerous extremist group.

videos.title: Code Name: Day of the Dead
videos.overview: The team is hired to recover stolen gold in Puerto Vallarta, and ends up dealing with competing factions who are also looking for it.

videos.title: Code Name: Dream Girl
videos.overview: A young woman asks the team for asylum in exchange for information about a terrorist.

videos.title: Code Name: The Killing Club
videos.overview: A man asks the team to look for his missing nephew, but Tommy's search on a private island leads to his own kidnapping.

videos.title: Code Name: Mr. Paradise
videos.overview: A mob boss calls a contract on the people connected with a car accident that killed his son.

videos.title: Code Name: The Mouse That Squeaked
videos.overview: A peace activist starting his own republic may be robbing banks to finance his venture.

videos.title: Code Name: Easy Green
videos.overview: A payment turns out to be in phony money, spurring the gang to take on a counterfeiting ring.

videos.title: Code Name: Dangerous Bait
videos.overview: Cat poses as the wife of a visiting dignitary to prevent a kidnapping.

videos.title: Code Name: Million Dollar Man
videos.overview: A mafioso wants to turn himself in to the authorities and give the reward to his daughter as a wedding present, so he hires the team to protect him from a rival mob.

videos.title: Code Name: Death of a Friendship
videos.overview: The team investigates the car-bombing murder of the president of a Caribbean island.

videos.title: Code Name: Sister Soothsayer
videos.overview: A psychic hires the team to find her brother, whom she suspects is in El Salvador.

videos.title: Code Name: Hot Chains
videos.overview: The sister of a kidnap victim hires the H.E.A.T. team to investigate a possible white-slavery ring.

videos.title: Code Name: Till Death Do Us Part
videos.overview: A widow needs the team to prove her husband is really dead and not faking it, but their investigation reveals that the man has several other grieving wives.

videos.title: Code Name: Cumshaw
videos.overview: The murder of a soldier and a string of arms thefts leads an army colonel to hire the team to secretly investigate the crimes.

videos.title: Code Name: Phantom
videos.overview: A film director hires the H.E.A.T. team to investigate a series of accidents that occurred on the set.

videos.title: Code Name: Bucket of Blood
videos.overview: Doctors learn that the blood of a wounded criminal could save the lives of sick children, but the man escapes before they can collect it from him.

videos.title: Code Name: Cult Zero
videos.overview: The H.E.A.T. team is asked to provide security for a supposedly peaceable cult, but Johanna is drawn to the organization. Then her companions learn the cult's real purpose.

videos.title: Code Name: Blood Ties
videos.overview: A former H.E.A.T. member enlists Nicole and the team to save his fiancée after she's kidnapped by her own father, a powerful senator opposed to the impending nuptials.

videos.title: Code Name: Matador
videos.overview: Cat urges her cohorts into action after she witnesses the death of a drug dealer and uncovers a mysterious conspiracy of silence on behalf of the proper officials.

videos.title: Code Name: Juice
videos.overview: A female D.E.A. agent helps the team bust a ring of drug smugglers supplying illegal steroids to athletes after Tommy's karate opponent dies during a match.

videos.title: Code Name: Lollipop, Lollipop
videos.overview: The team tries to rescue a millionaire's niece who was abducted by a South American drug czar, but it seems she may not want to be saved.

videos.title: Code Name: The Stolen Leg
videos.overview: Hired by a tennis star to track down his missing prosthetic limb, the team stumbles upon a counterfeiting ring that needs the contents of the athlete's appendage.

videos.title: Code Name: Flight 401
videos.overview: The team springs into action after an embittered ex-CIA operative seizes control of a commercial flight.

videos.title: Code Name: I Remember
videos.overview: In the series finale, through a series of flashbacks and clips, the team members recall their most daring rescues.
